pageRules: Elective requirements: Engineering Communications Requirement; one CEE Capstone Design Elective; two CEE Design Electives; two Major-approved Electives; two Advisor-approved Electives; one additional science course.
Students must address two distinct engineering contexts within their three required design courses.

CEE Civil Engineering Major Handbook (Wayback, about 2025): students must take a total of five courses from the lists of electives; at least three must be CEE design courses, one of which must be a capstone.

Additional science (Engineering Handbook Fall 2025 note j; CEE handbook): one basic science course beyond the required physics and chemistry; chemistry and physics courses cannot be used. Approved: BIOG 1440, BIOMG 1350, BIOEE 1610, EAS 1540, EAS 2250, EAS 3030, EAS 3050, EAS 3410, EAS 3420, EAS 3530; others by petition. It may simultaneously satisfy another requirement such as an advisor-approved elective.

Engineering Communications (note c): if met with a course that fulfills another requirement, the student must take an additional advisor-approved elective unless the 125 minimum credits are already met. ENGRC 3610 (with CEE 3610) is recommended.

pageRules: A total of 6 courses across capstone design, design and major-approved electives must be selected from among the courses in the list. At least three of these six courses must be capstone design or design electives. At least one of the three design electives must be a capstone design elective.
Capstone design (**): CEE 4210, CEE 4565, BEE 4730. Design (*): CEE 4880, CEE 4350, CEE 4200, CEE 4665, CEE 4795, CEE 4800, CEE 4640; CEE 6370 per the footnote.
Earth Science: BEE 3710, EAS 2250, EAS 2680, EAS 3010, EAS 3030, EAS 3050, PLSCI 2600, PLSCI 3650, NTRES 3240; more advanced Earth Science courses generally accepted by petition.
Engineering Handbook Fall 2025 note e: introductory biology may also be BIOSM 1610 or BIOSM 1780.
